pages.en:
Boy Author Of Warning
To Evepost Bomb Attack

A Chinese boy of 10 who was apparently overwhelmed by the pre-April Fool Day spirits was responsible for the bold prediction that the Shanghai Evening Post offices, already twice bombed by terrorists, were to be attacked again on April 6, it was revealed today.

With a keen sense of humor, the school boy who had arrived from his native home in Nantung, North Kiangsu, only a few months ago, made use of the stationary of a now defunct "Phoenix Radio Advertising Company" and mailed his "prediction" to the Evening Post, warning the newspaper that it would again be a target of bomb-tossers. He mailed the "warning" a day too early, for it arrived at the newspaper office on March 31.

The stationary, however, betrayed his identity. His brother, Mr. Kao Sheng-yen, employed in a bank, read about the "fresh threat" on the Evening Post was startled to find the name of the defunct advertising company. The company was owned by Mr. Kao's friend who had left with him a quantity of unused stationery. He immediately checked the handwriting and found it the work of his kid brother.

Mr. Kao promptly wrote to the Evening Post today apologizing for the practical joke, adding that he has severely reprimanded his brother for his style of humor.

The boy explained that he had signed himself "Taoist Priest of Spring and Autumn" because he found the title "mysterious" and figures in his story books with names of that nature always interested him.

向《字林西报》发出炸弹袭击警告的男孩作者

据今日披露，一名10岁的中国男孩显然被愚人节前的气氛所感染，大胆预言《字林西报》馆——此前已两次遭恐怖分子炸弹袭击——将于4月6日再次遭到攻击。

这名几个月前刚从江苏南通老家来到上海的学童颇具幽默感，他利用一家现已停业的“凤凰无线电广告公司”的信纸，将他的“预言”寄给《字林西报》，警告该报将再次成为投掷炸弹者的目标。他寄出这封“警告信”的时间早了一天，因为信件于3月31日才送达报社。

然而，信纸暴露了他的身份。在银行任职的哥哥高升炎（Kao Sheng-yen，音译）先生在《字林西报》上读到这一“新威胁”时，惊讶地发现了那家已停业广告公司的名称。该公司由高先生的朋友所有，这位朋友曾留给他一批未使用的信纸。他立即核对笔迹，发现出自其小弟之手。

高先生今日 promptly 致信《字林西报》为此恶作剧道歉，并称已因这种幽默风格严厉斥责了其弟。

男孩解释说，他署名“春秋道人”，是因为觉得这个头衔很“神秘”，而且故事书中此类名字的人物总是令他感兴趣。

Ta Mei Wan Pao Morning Edition and other local newspapers :-
1/4/38 (A.M.) "TA MEI WAN PAO MORNING EDITION" RECEIVES A STRANGE LETTER

The "Ta Mei Wan Pao Morning Edition" (大美晨刊)
has been attacked on two different occasions by terrorists.
On March 31, the paper received a letter bearing the name
"Tsung Tseu Deo Zung" (春秋道人) ("Spring and Autumn
Taoist Priest") addressed to the General Manager, and which
reads as follows :-
"This Taoist priest is well acquainted with
geomancy. It has now been found that your paper will
certainly be bombed on April 6. Care should be exercised".
This letter was sent by post on March 26. Its
envelope bears the following printed words:- "The Feng
Feng Radio Advertising Company" (豐豐無線電廣告公司). A
chop of the Post Office for insufficient postage is affixed
to the envelope.

《大美晚报》早版及其他本地报纸：
1938年4月1日（上午）《大美晚报》早版收到一封奇怪信件

《大美晚报》（大美晨刊）
曾两次遭到恐怖分子袭击。
3月31日，该报收到一封署名为
“Tsung Tseu Deo Zung”（春秋道人）（“Spring and Autumn
Taoist Priest”）并致总经理的信件，内容
如下：
“本道人对风水堪舆颇为精通。现算得
贵报必将于4月6日遭炸弹袭击。务请
小心防范。”
此信于3月26日通过邮局寄出。信封
上印有如下字样：“豐豐無線電廣告公司”
（The Feng Feng Radio Advertising Company）。信封
上贴有邮局因邮资不足而加盖的戳记。
